title: Ordinary finite scalar and pullback comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and n≥0. Let δ:finiteDirect(f)⋙scalarRestr(Y,n)≅scalarRestr(X,n)⋙completedDirect(f) be finiteDirectImage_eq followed by the sectionwise ringed restriction/direct-image comparison. Construct ν:completedPull(f)⋙scalarExt(X,n)≅scalarExt(Y,n)⋙levelPull(f,n) as left-adjoint uniqueness after transferring the first composite adjunction across δ⁻¹. For every ordinary completed module M on Y, its transpose under the completed-pull/scalar-extension composite adjunction is (scalarAdj(Y,n).comp levelAdj(f,n)).unit_M followed by δ_(levelPull(scalarExt(Y,n)(M))). The components ν_(P.X i) assemble to an actual cochain map for every cochain complex P.

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Construct the restriction/direct-image square by finiteDirectImage_eq followed by the ringed restriction/direct-image comparison. Transfer the composite scalar and geometric adjunction across its inverse and take leftAdjointUniq with the finite geometric composite adjunction. Its unit normalization gives ordinaryFiniteScalarPull_transpose, by cancellation of the invertible right comparison. Apply the ordinary natural isomorphism degreewise to construct the cochain map; naturality proves its compatibility with differentials.

theorem ordinaryFiniteScalarPull_transpose {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) :
    let ar := proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
      ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)
    let ax := pullbackTensorFiniteAdjunction l E X n
    let ay := pullbackTensorFiniteAdjunction l E Y n
    let e := coefficientProEtaleModuleAdjunction.{u, u} f
      (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))))
    (ar.comp ax).homEquiv M _ ((ordinaryFiniteScalarPull l E f n).hom.app M) =
      (ay.comp e).unit.app M ≫ (finiteScalarRestrictionDirect l E f n).hom.app
        ((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n).obj
          ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).obj M))
